name: Ergo Memory
description: Decision memory that remembers WHY, and refuses to silently contradict itself -- backed by a self-hosted Ergo engine.

baseUrl.description: Ergo API base URL. Set to an empty string to disable this plugin.

apiToken.description: Ergo API bearer token. Leave unset for an open/dev instance.

project.description: Ergo project scope for this agent. Defaults to the harness agent id when unset, else "openclaw".

autoRecall.description: Inject relevant Ergo memory before every prompt (read-only GET /recall).

autoCapture.description: Opt-in: post each completed turn to Ergo's gate-free POST /ingest (never /remember). Off by default -- see README.

recallLimit.description: Max memories injected per auto-recall / memory_recall call. 50 is Ergo's own GET /recall clamp (docs/HTTP-API.md) -- a higher value here would be misleading, not just unenforced.

project.label: Project scope
project.help: Namespace within Ergo's (org_id, project) scoping. See README for the resolution order.

autoCapture.label: Auto-capture (opt-in)
autoCapture.help: Ergo is a decision store with mandatory reasons; unlike other memory plugins, capture is off by default. See README.
